mapper.select: SELECT inquiry_file_no AS inquiryFileNo, inquiry_no AS inquiryNo, file_url AS fileUrl, file_name AS fileName, file_size AS fileSize, file_type AS fileType, created_at AS createdAt, delete_yn AS deleteYn FROM inquiry_file WHERE inquiry_no = #{inquiryNo} AND delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY created_at ASC
